coordinate_policy: Raw native pixels, matching annotation/mask dimensions; absent/0/1 EXIF accepted. PNG crops contain no orientation metadata. No transposition or rescaling of annotation coordinates.
negative_policy: 64-pixel square fully inside an original Background, Power transformer, Muffle or Breaker polygon, disjoint from every material bounding box. Source-derived non-target crops, not expert-verified material negatives or polymer evidence.
automatic_localisation: Reuse all existing Grounding DINO proposals and their verified SigLIP2 embeddings; no detector rerun, no target source boxes used for automatic inference.
oracle_diagnostic: Separately classify original UVInsDet target polygon crops; these source boxes are an oracle diagnostic and must never be presented as automatic localisation.
evaluation_scope: Same-substation development and eight already inspected external demo images; NOT independent UK accuracy. No model or threshold search, no encoder fine-tuning, no polymer claim.
budget: One gputest job, 15 minutes. One fixed head, 400 full-batch steps. Do not automatically resubmit or extend.
